stable_id_decision.instruction: Before implementing an ID extraction, inspect the existing schema/model and determine whether a stable job ID field already exists and whether the captured URL evidence is sufficient to populate it safely.
stable_id_decision.finding: a stable ID field (job_id) already exists in the pipeline schema (scripts/discover_local.py normalize_job() -> scripts/job_id.py generate_job_id()), and is already correctly populated as an automatic consequence of the job_url fix -- no new code needed
existing_priority_order: 1. source-provided job_id (none provided by any adapter today)
2. deterministic hash of source + normalized job_url (job_id_from_url())
3. fallback hash of source + company + title + location (job_id_from_fields()), used only when no usable job_url exists
reasons_not_implemented: the raw-job-dict schema (_empty_raw_job()) has no field for a source-native numeric ID today; adding one would be a schema change beyond this task's minimal scope
it would be purely redundant with the URL-based job_id mechanism that already exists and now already works correctly

Step 9's own report explicitly framed the URL's numeric suffix as an unconfirmed inference (likely Hirist's internal job ID), not a confirmed fact -- no second live capture has verified the digits are stable/unique across re-crawls rather than a listing-position artifact
stable_id_decision.conclusion: existing schema already supports a stable ID; captured URL evidence is sufficient to populate it safely and already does so automatically via the existing job_id_from_url() pipeline; no new stable-ID extraction code was added to hirist_parser.py
